"The trade replay issue of reporting ‘REPL’ instead of ‘NEWM’ to TRAX on our active trades (not being archived in CMRS) caused by the RH archiving story 2323911 is impacting the #13 fix changes. The new ESP extract for #13 are sending replay messages of rebooked trades which are updated with original Position Trader information based on OMS trade linkages. Since they are all replay messages (<SST_REPLAY> = ‘Y’), RH will report them as ‘REPL’ to TRAX. The #13 replay messages will be all rejected by TRAX as they have never been reported to TRAX before. In short, #13 replayed trade messages will be like other BAU replay messages all get rejected which means the #13 changes from ESP and RH are all useless. "
